self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2504 designs an engineering benchmark pack and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.

self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a public benchmark pack cannot be bounded, route to synthesis or artifact repair rather than weakening self-ID or validation gates.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, driver-performance verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A bounded public benchmark pack design can package the source-only engineering diagnostic evidence without overstating performance, validation, ranking, or paper claims.
success_criteria: design defines benchmark pack contents artifact manifest exclusions and claim boundaries
design preserves P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3
design keeps hidden diagnostics oracle labels TTC required clearance reward terms and success labels out of actor input
design defines materialization artifacts tests and audit gates
design registers a bounded follow-up milestone
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2504 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2504 changes actor input or action contract
M2504 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2504 executes policy actions or rollout
M2504 treats benchmark pack design as driver performance
M2504 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2504 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result
decision_rule: M2504 passes if it designs a bounded public engineering benchmark pack and registers a follow-up materialization or audit route without external simulation, policy action, training, ranking, winner selection, success-rate, or verdict claims.
